turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Owen's essay. Why was the zero entered before anyone called me?
Can I ask something off the record?
There's no off the record in this room. Answer my question: why was the zero entered before anyone called me?
When was the last time you actually sat with him while he did homework?
I'm not the one being questioned. Who decided on the zero, and what did you have when you decided?
Because in my experience, kids who cheat have parents who are too busy to notice.
My child never lies. Are you calling me a liar, Hale, or calling Owen a cheater? Say which, and say what you have.
